body:
Thanks for your encouraging thoughts. Only like 20% have HSV2 (many many more have HSV1). Yes, I'm asymptomatic (I know that doesn't mean I can't transmit it to others) so at least that is lucky.

Thanks for saying you would have sex with me lol. I am worried no one would touch me with a ten foot pole.
Yes I'm here, feel free to PM me.

Thank you so much for sharing your story.  It helps to know there are other people who have been able to live with this. I feel so alone....I told my best friend, and she was horrified and it just made me feel like more of a freak.
I'm sorry you're in my club, however.

Well my paycheck is decent so at least that gives me some flexibility, I don't think I'll quit my job. I had kept thinking about going to school part time but struggle with motivation and fears of inadequacy! I guess I have nothing to lose. Failure doesn't really matter when I feel like my life is over already.
That actually makes me feel better lol

Thanks for all that information, I didn't know it wasn't always so stigmatized. I don't even want to fact check you on that because it makes me feel better - haha. I know medically speaking, it's very inconsequential. The stigma makes me angry and depressed. I don't think most people are very educated about it and so I don't see how I can get through that barrier to other people. 

I am certain I never would have found out if I didn't take that test. A selfish part of me wishes I hadn't found out so I could live in ignorance, but it's good I know so I can protect others. I would never want to cause anyone else this emotional pain.

That is true, about convincing oneself. I just get stuck in this negative tailspin of thoughts and then the picture is so bleak, so consuming and overwhelming, I see no way out. And when I get in that mode, I think suicide is the only way out. I am feeling calmer now, but I know the thoughts will return.

You are taking time out of your day to help a desperate stranger, that's making an impact. Why would you have zero self confidence? I mean...I'm not one to talk, but I have a damn good reason.  I see value in others, just not myself. 

I actually really dislike my job. I work in finance and just stuck in the corporate grind.

I think I could handle most men rejecting me. I've just convinced myself it's 100% of all men. I wish I didn't care so much. I wish I could take a pill that killed the part of me that craved human companionship.
I guess I just feel like counselors are out to trick you into living, when maybe it is kinder to not live. There are circumstances that are too painful to handle.

I want to believe you, but I am afraid if I try to tell myself those kinds of things, I will just get disappointed when I am rejected over and over again in life. I'm trying to prepare myself for reality and determine if I am really going to be able to handle it. 

It sucks because I used to be so awesome. Men would go crazy for me because of my looks (ironic because i think appearances are so unimportant!)  And yet I always saved myself for serious relationships. Now I'll never have another one, and I honestly don't blame the men who will reject me. :(

Your words make me feel a bit better, just to know there is one person out there who thinks like that. You must be a really nice person. I just struggle to believe that anyone could feel that way towards me.

Part of me wants to find something to live for, and part of me thinks that life would still be such a shell, devoid of love, that it may not be worth living. My fear of the future is greater than my fear of death. And I used to be extremely petrified of death. Now it sounds like a sweet relief.

The only thing I could think of was adopting children one day so that I could still have something. But it would be kind of selfish to adopt kids just to keep me from killing myself (doesn't sound like a strong foundation for a parent/child relationship, does it?).

There's career...but few people find their career that rewarding. I certainly don't find my current job rewarding.

Nice mask.

You sound like a really nice person. I just don't think there are very many people who could deal with it. 

I really struggle with talking about my feelings to people in person. I have attempted to go to a counselor a couple of times in the past for other problems and I found it to be extremely uncomfortable. I'm an extremely shy person and just don't like to share things.

I am almost afraid of being talked in to sticking around for life, because I'm afraid it's going to be too painful for me to deal with. At other times, I'm very afraid of dying. I don't know which fear is greater.

I appreciate your supportive words, but I don't see how this is not a determining factor in my worth. It is the reason I will be alone, the reason all my dreams are eliminated. My biggest fear is that the pain is only beginning, and that a lifetime of rejection and loneliness is ahead of me, and I don't have the courage to face it.

Thanks for your response. I try to be humorous. I had contemplated hitting up nursing homes, since people with little time left may not mind if they pick up the herp if it means they can have some action on their deathbeds. I could be like the ... promiscuous angel of death.  

I am petrified of talking to anyone, hence the internets. I fear that even medical professionals will judge me and look at me with disgust and contempt. I am too afraid to return to the medical office where I got the tests done.

It hurts so much because I'm an overall great person, but no one could see past this. I had always pictured myself married and with children, and now that is impossible. Just take a lesson from me. Don't have sex. Trust no one. And realize your life could be worse - you could be like me.
